hero.title: Turn Any File Into Structured Data
hero.subtitle: Upload Excel, PDF, images, or emails. AI extracts and structures the data. You review and approve. Data flows into your systems automatically.

features.title: Everything you need to automate data entry
features.subtitle: From file upload to system integration, DataBridge handles the entire workflow.

ai.title: AI-Powered Extraction
ai.desc: Supports Excel, PDF, images, emails and more. AI understands context and extracts structured data accurately.

review.title: Human-in-the-Loop Review
review.desc: Every extraction goes through your review before being sent to your systems. Edit, approve, or reject with one click.

webhook.title: Automatic System Integration
webhook.desc: Define your API endpoint once. Approved data is automatically sent to your CRM, ERP, or any business system.

template.title: Reusable Templates
template.desc: Create templates with custom prompts and output schemas. Reuse them across your team for consistent results.

i18n.title: Multi-Language Support
i18n.desc: Full support for English, Chinese, and Japanese. Your team works in their preferred language.

secure.title: Enterprise Security
secure.desc: SOC 2 compliant. Your data is encrypted at rest and in transit. We never train on your data.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free, upgrade when you need more.
